description: Stage 4a dedicated cases: block statements `{ ... }` are claimed by the StatementShape shell (Kind=ShellBlock); the `{` ambiguity is decided only in StatementRouteUtil.Decide. Each case asserts: (1) shell-path XML == legacy-path XML (EnableShellExpressions=false) byte for byte; (2) AST node-for-node == ts.createSourceFile; (3) two parses of the same source give identical XML (determinism); (4) no StatementShape node leaks into the shape tree.

stage4-block.stage: Stage 4a (block statement shell + block body catalog infra)
stage4-block.description: Block statement shell: `{}`, `{ let x = 1; f(); }`, `{ if (a) b; }`, nested block, in-block ASI, in-block comment, function / method body, `{ "s"; }`, `{ a.b; }`, two blocks in a row, `({ a: 1 });` (object literal must be unaffected).
